subsystems.name: Feed preparation
subsystems.role: delivers a clean, steady methane stream and meters it precisely into the reactor.

subsystems.name: Reactor
subsystems.role: the hot zone where methane molecules are torn apart into hydrogen and elemental carbon.
parts: plasma torch or molten-metal bath or fluidised bed

subsystems.name: Carbon removal
subsystems.role: takes solid carbon out of the hot zone without letting it clog the reactor.

subsystems.name: Gas clean-up
subsystems.role: separates hydrogen from unreacted methane and traces of heavier hydrocarbons.

subsystems.name: Heat recovery
subsystems.role: recovers heat from the very hot product gas to cut the electricity demand.

subsystems.name: Hydrogen conditioning
subsystems.role: brings hydrogen to pipeline or industrial purity and pressure.

subsystems.name: Carbon product finishing
subsystems.role: turns the solid output into a saleable grade of carbon black or graphite.

buildSteps.title: Choose the cracking route
buildSteps.detail: Thermal plasma, a molten-metal bath and a catalytic fluidised bed each handle carbon fouling differently; the choice sets the whole plant layout.

buildSteps.title: Design the reactor for carbon
buildSteps.detail: Solid carbon is abrasive, conductive and tends to deposit on hot surfaces, so gas flow, wall temperature and residence time are engineered to keep it moving.

buildSteps.title: Build the heated reactor
buildSteps.detail: Refractory-lined vessel, electrodes or bath heater and gas distributor are assembled and leak-tested at temperature.

buildSteps.title: Add carbon discharge
buildSteps.detail: Screws, cyclones and filters are fitted so carbon leaves continuously rather than building up.

buildSteps.title: Install gas separation
buildSteps.detail: Adsorption or membrane units strip unreacted methane, which is recycled to the reactor to raise overall conversion.

buildSteps.title: Integrate heat recovery
buildSteps.detail: Exchangers capture heat from the product gas to preheat feed and, where possible, raise steam.

buildSteps.title: Commission and characterise the carbon
buildSteps.detail: The plant is run on methane and the solid output tested for purity, particle size and structure, because its value as carbon black or graphite decides the economics.

buildSteps.title: Scale in modules
buildSteps.detail: Plants are built as parallel reactor trains so capacity can grow without redesigning a single giant vessel.

prerequisites.why: plasma and electric heating only count as low-carbon if the power is; otherwise the process emits CO2 upstream at the generator.
reactors must survive over 1,000 °C with abrasive carbon and thermal cycling.
pressure-swing adsorption and membranes are mature industrial equipment.

prerequisites.tech: A market for the solid carbon
prerequisites.why: carbon black and synthetic graphite have established buyers, but a large new supply needs consistent quality certification.
fugitive methane from extraction can undermine the climate case, so certified gas or biomethane is preferred.

pathway.milestone: pilot and demonstration plants in Australia, Europe and North America making hydrogen alongside carbon black or graphite
pathway.unlocks: operating data on reactor fouling and carbon quality.

pathway.milestone: first commercial-scale plants with contracted carbon offtake
pathway.unlocks: revenue from the solid product that offsets hydrogen cost.
the carbon is biogenic, so the whole chain can be near carbon-negative.

pathway.milestone: integration with industrial gas hubs and carbon-product supply chains
pathway.unlocks: a route to hydrogen that avoids CO2 capture and storage entirely.
